Use disjoint calibration and held-out sets and predeclare scoring and thresholds. Track prompt mix, batching, cache warmth, compilation, background load, throttling, retries and thermal drift as confounders; distinguish measured facts from estimates and include failed work plus host, power and infrastructure costs.
